acceptanceCriteria: A unique repository-bound predecessor-bound recovery successor can pass current preflight and continue its lifecycle without creating a competing successor when an unrelated archived scope is untrusted.
A candidate scope that can be proven disjoint from an unrelated archived Work Item does not receive a global archived_work_item_scope_untrusted blocker for that recovery successor.
A candidate scope that may overlap an archived scope, has a mismatched recovery edge, or lacks a unique repository-bound recovery decision remains blocked.
Malformed, foreign, stale, symlink, and digest-mismatched archive, Contract, manifest, recovery, and successor evidence remain fail-closed; historical bytes remain unchanged.
Ordinary new Work Item archived-scope conflicts, active-resource conflicts, successor ambiguity rejection, and strict close validation remain unchanged.
CLI/MCP use the shared decision path and English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese docs describe the same recovery semantics with deterministic regression fixtures.
goal: Make a repository-bound, predecessor-bound recovery continuation able to complete preflight through close when unrelated archived scope evidence is untrusted, without weakening ordinary Work Item conflict checks or historical evidence integrity.
intent: Resolve Issue #851 by allowing only identity-bound recovery successors to continue past proven-unrelated historical scope unknowns while preserving fail-closed overlap and evidence checks.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A unique repository-bound predecessor-bound recovery successor can proceed when an unrelated archived scope is proven disjoint.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the repository recovery fixture with a disjoint untrusted archived scope and assert the successor preflight is not blocked by the unrelated scope.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Potential overlap, mismatched recovery edges, and missing unique repository-bound decisions remain fail-closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run recovery fixtures for overlap, foreign predecessor, missing decision, and ambiguous lineage and assert the existing blockers remain.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Malformed, stale, symlinked, foreign, and digest-mismatched evidence is not accepted or skipped.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the lifecycle-entry tamper fixtures for archive, Contract, manifest, recovery, and successor evidence.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Ordinary new Work Item archived-scope conflicts and active-resource conflicts retain their existing blockers.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run existing ordinary preflight conflict fixtures alongside the recovery-specific fixtures.

scenarioCoverage.expected: CLI, MCP, English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese recovery outputs use the same decision path and facts.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run CLI/MCP parity tests and the three localized repository-workflow reference checks.
